title: Case 020: A multi-parcel order arrives with one parcel still outstanding

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: An order consists of three separately tracked parcels. Two are received; the third must be traced by its own identifier.
initial_request: I received two of the three cartons for TG-020. The missing carton is DL-020-C. Please locate it; I am available tomorrow.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the carrier to locate the missing parcel using its individual tracking ID.
next_action.recipient: Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics

outcome: The recipient confirms receipt of that remaining parcel; the order's parcel count reconciles.
boundaries: Closure is for the three-parcel count, not product quality or installation.

events.body: Order TG-020 has parcels DL-020-A, DL-020-B and DL-020-C. A and B have delivery scans; C has an inbound depot scan only. All three are required to complete the order.
I received two of the three cartons for TG-020. The missing carton is DL-020-C. Please locate it; I am available tomorrow.

events.to: Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: Please trace DL-020-C specifically and arrange its remaining delivery. Do not mark TG-020 complete using only the A and B scans.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-020-C was in the oversize rack and is now on the 2026-02-22 route. Its route handover scan will be reported separately.
DL-020-C arrived at 14:10 UTC on 2026-02-22. I now have A, B and C: three cartons, matching TG-020.
